name: Event Channel Managarr
description: Automates channel visibility by hiding channels without events and showing those with events, based on EPG data and channel names. Optionally manages dummy EPG for channels without real EPG.
author: PiratesIRC

fields.label: 📍 Scope
fields.description: Which channels this plugin is allowed to touch, and which name it reads on each one.

fields.label: 🎯 Hide Rules
fields.description: The ordered list of rules that decides which channels get hidden, plus the regular expressions that skip, hide or protect a channel by name.

fields.label: 🎭 Duplicates
fields.description: What to do when several channels carry the same event at the same time.

fields.label: 🔌 EPG Management
fields.description: Optional guide-data automation: clearing EPG from channels as they are hidden, and giving visible channels with no guide data a dummy EPG built from their names.

fields.label: ⏰ Scheduling & Export
fields.description: Unattended runs: the times the scan starts by itself, and whether those runs leave a CSV behind.

fields.label: ⚙️ Advanced
fields.description: Pacing for very large profiles. Leave this alone unless a scan is putting the database under strain.

actions.label: Validate Configuration
actions.description: Saves the settings above, then checks them for problems: an invalid regular expression, a profile or channel group that does not exist, a malformed schedule. Changes no channels.

actions.label: Update Schedule
actions.description: Saves the settings above and re-arms the background scheduler with the run times you entered. Use this after editing Scheduled Run Times.

actions.label: Dry Run (Export to CSV)
actions.description: Reports which channels WOULD be hidden or shown and writes the full list to a CSV in /data/exports. Changes nothing.

actions.label: Run Now
actions.description: Scans now and applies the visibility changes straight away, using the settings as they are currently saved.

confirm.message: This will apply visibility changes and (if enabled) attach/detach managed EPG. Continue?

actions.label: Auto-rescan after M3U refresh
actions.description: Runs a visibility scan automatically after each M3U refresh, but only while '🔄 Auto-rescan after M3U refresh' is enabled in the settings above. There is no button: Dispatcharr triggers it.

actions.label: Remove EPG from Hidden Channels
actions.description: Clears the EPG assignment from every channel that is currently hidden in the configured profiles, in one pass. Use it to tidy up channels hidden before 'Auto-Remove EPG on Hide' was turned on.

confirm.message: This will CLEAR EPG data from every hidden channel in the selected profile. Cannot be undone by this plugin. Continue?

actions.label: Clear CSV Exports
actions.description: Deletes every CSV file this plugin has written to /data/exports. No channel or EPG data is touched.

confirm.message: This will delete every CSV file in /data/exports created by this plugin. Continue?

actions.label: Cleanup Orphaned Tasks
actions.description: Removes Celery periodic tasks left behind by older versions of this plugin, which scheduled runs through Celery instead of the built-in scheduler. Harmless to run when there are none.

confirm.message: This removes orphaned Celery periodic tasks left by older plugin versions. Continue?

actions.label: Check Scheduler Status
actions.description: Shows whether this worker's background scheduler thread is running, which times it is armed for, when the next one is due and when a scan last ran.
